description: This file defines logging levels, visibility macros, and declares external logging functions for different log levels, along with macros to generate logging functions with specified levels and modules.

methods.name: clog_vlog_debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message with specified module, format, and arguments.

methods.name: clog_vlog_info
methods.description: Logs an info message with specified module, format, and arguments.

methods.name: clog_vlog_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with specified module, format, and arguments.

methods.name: clog_vlog_error
methods.description: Logs an error message with specified module, format, and arguments.

methods.name: clog_vlog_fatal
methods.description: Logs a fatal error message with specified module, format, and arguments, then aborts.
